ArmstrongKolesar2018 uses convex-class worst-case bias geometry; the ordered finite-block TV support identity is a specialized, routine extension.

repo_prior_art.cite: exp_rollout_chebyshev_minimax is a distinct rollout-design TV-envelope problem, not NCC borrowing inference.

published_prior_art.cite: LiZhao2026 has adaptive-AIPW asymptotic inference and SawadaNomuraShinozaki2026 has model-based external-control borrowing, neither a finite-sample uniform randomization interval over TV-bounded fixed schedules.
CaiLow2004 gives Gaussian all-interval mixture lower-bound logic; no checked source handles TV-admissible fuzzy priors under schedule-dependent adaptive assignment likelihoods.

repo_prior_art.cite: exp_two_wave_endpoint_poisson_minimax concerns a two-wave superpopulation allocation problem, not NCC interval length under calendar drift.

published_prior_art.cite: ArmstrongKolesar2018 and CaiLow2004 are Gaussian convex-class interval results; SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026 studies finite-population estimation risk rather than honest NCC interval length.
BofillRoigEtAl2022 analyzes model-based NCC precision under trend assumptions; the stated KKT equivalence is a standard convex-optimization certificate applied to a new objective.
The endpoint reductions are natural consequences of the proposed TV class and optimizer, rather than an independently new published frontier.
No checked NCC paper solves the stated finite all-honest-interval linear program, though this is a supporting diagnostic rather than a central novelty claim.

soundness_flags.label: def:honest-minimax-length / thm:minimax-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The class C_alpha does not restrict I to observed-data-measurable procedures or specify the auxiliary randomness for randomized intervals, so L_star can admit schedule-dependent zero-length intervals or exclude the randomized procedures claimed by the theorem.

soundness_flags.label: def:strict-gain-certificate / prop:strict-improvement-iff
soundness_flags.one_line: Psi_{alpha,gamma} is used to define Gamma_cc but is never defined; the core only defines Psi_alpha at the globally fixed Gamma.

soundness_flags.label: prop:three-block-kill-test
soundness_flags.one_line: The reported LP values are not determined by the stated specialization: W, q, every assignment probability/history rule, and the precise focal-block availability design are omitted.

source_verification_receipts.version: BMC Medical Research Methodology 22:228 (2022), corrected publication
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies a two-treatment-arm shared-control platform setting and finds that model-based NCC use can gain efficiency but is biased when equal additive time-trend assumptions fail.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 4.1, Theorem 4 discussion; Section 4.2, Theorem 5 discussion; proof lines identifying the AIPW martingale differences
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops finite-population AIPW theory under adaptive randomization; its AIPW sequence is a martingale-difference construction and Theorem 4 supplies its CLT under additional regularity conditions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 655-656 abstract; pp. 669-671, Corollaries 3.1-3.2 and fixed-length CI discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives optimal honest confidence intervals and efficiency bounds for convex regression classes under normal errors, including affine-estimator bias-variance constructions and minimax expected-length results in its Gaussian experiment.

The paper develops expected-length lower bounds and constant-factor adaptive confidence intervals for linear functionals in Gaussian white-noise or sequence experiments through between-class and ordered moduli.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Section 3.3 determination of tuning parameter
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proposes dynamic external-control borrowing with a prespecified expected-bias tolerance cap under a model-based confounding analysis; it is not a fixed-schedule design-based minimax interval theorem.

The paper studies minimax-optimal designs and estimators for the finite-population sample ATE under binary potential outcomes and estimation risk, not uniformly honest NCC confidence-interval expected length under drift.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define C_alpha as observed-history Markov kernels into closed intervals and put any auxiliary randomizer explicitly into the experiment; then define both coverage and expected length under the extended design law.

Replace Psi_{alpha,gamma} with an explicitly parameterized objective and state the exact B=3 witness completely, including W, q, arm availability, assignment probabilities, and whether interval actions may randomize.

Stress-test the proposed p-minus worst-path radius against designs with rare low-propensity histories; either prove the fuzzy-prior lower bound retains that dependence or reformulate the frontier using an average-design information modulus.

recommended_next_step: Revise the procedure class and underdetermined definitions, then retain this angle for Stage 0 as a field-tier adaptive-randomization NCC minimax frontier.
